scientific_integrity: The formulas count every radical element exactly once; standard Pfaffian and Grassmannian enumerations are identified as classical prerequisites. All claims are self-contained with proof and reproducible, finite corroboration; independent review remains outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Exactly four exterior generators and regular-module left multiplication. No independent certification, priority proof, automorphism-orbit classification, general number-of-generators theorem, or assertions about other modules. Finite computational checks involve prime fields; the uniform proof covers prime powers.
title: Complete radical-multiplication Jordan spectra of the four-generator exterior algebra
